steps.message: Turn on Wifi, then open the contacts app
Execute: adb shell svc wifi enable

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell svc wifi enable"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -n com.android.contacts/.activities.PeopleActivity

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -n com.android.contacts/.activities.PeopleActivity"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell pm list packages | grep -i contact

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell pm list packages | grep -i contact"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER com.android.contacts

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER com.android.contacts"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER com.google.android.contacts

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER com.google.android.contacts"

steps.message: Execute: adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -n com.google.android.contacts/com.android.contacts.activities.PeopleActivity

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER -n com.google.android.contacts/com.android.contacts.activities.PeopleActivity"
